name: Corpus-Bound Test and Simulation Cascade
principle: The admitted corpus is the semantic source for test and simulation inputs. Execution results are not treated as known, derivable or pre-populated merely because the corpus contains models, expectations or prior reasoning.

input_policy.runtime_form: Tests receive compact structured packets compiled from the corpus; they do not receive an undifferentiated full-corpus prompt unless a bounded specialist adapter explicitly requires it.
forbidden: invented literal parameter used because a source value is missing
LLM-estimated parameter silently substituted for a missing measurement
expected result copied into the result field before execution
downstream use of an upstream output before proof + readback + commit
mass hydration when a bounded packet is sufficient

unknown_policy.rule: Unknown inputs stay explicit and block execution or become a separately authorised measured/bounded sweep dimension; they are not filled by generation.

cascade_policy.ordering: topological; lowest declared complexity and smallest input surface first within each executable frontier
cascade_policy.example: For 16 dependent sweeps, resolve the simplest admissible sweep first; verify/prove/read back/commit its receipt; then unlock only the dependants whose required inputs are now final.
cascade_policy.parallelism: Independent tests in the same dependency layer may run concurrently only when resource, assurance and execution-lease gates allow it.

result_policy.propagation: Only final receipts may parameterise a downstream test. Prior expectations, model prose and uncommitted outputs cannot.

semantic_status_projection.rule: Top-down interfaces show the current semantic state while retaining the underlying source/input/result/proof lineage.
semantic_status_projection.complete: final execution receipt + proof + verified readback + committed receipt
semantic_status_projection.partial: some dependencies or inputs are resolved/final but the object is not final
semantic_status_projection.ready: all required packet inputs and dependency gates are final but execution has not started
semantic_status_projection.blocked: one or more required sources, dependencies, capabilities, authorities or proofs are unresolved

integration.query_normalisation: FFQP/PQH/CNR selects the smallest relevant corpus subgraph and capability
integration.receipts: append-only run/result evidence; semantic promotion remains separate

requirements: execution lease where execution is requested
